text: You might have heard certain things about investing from friends, family, or social media. There are a lot of common misconceptions about investing, so we're here to give you the facts. Myth one: Investing is hard and complicated, and it's only for Boomers. Anybody can invest, and we're here to make it easy! Over one million users are already learning and investing on Bloom. Myth two: I'm going to need a lot of money to start. On Bloom, you can start investing with just one dollar, and even small investments can become big over time. Myth three: I don't have time to invest now, so I'll just start later. You don't need a lot of time to get started! Bloom lets you learn and invest at your own pace, and the earlier you start, the more time you give your money to grow. Myth four: I'm going to lose a lot of money, and it's super risky. You can always choose safer investments, and Bloom will teach you how to pick what to invest in. Start your investing journey on Bloom today.
